chapter.verse: Tua sawng tengin Judea gamgawtak lakah Baptizepa John hong pai-in thu tangko a,
“Kisik un, a hang pen vantung kumpigam hong tung kuanta hi,” ci hi.
A hang pen ama' thu kamsang Isaiah in hih bangin na gen khin hi: “Gamgawtak laka kikopa' awging in, ‘Topa' lampi sialkhol unla ama' zawi tangsak un,’ ci hi.”
Tu-in John in kalaoh mul puantual silhin a kawng ah savun kawnggak gak a, a annek pen kauphe leh gamlak khuaizu ahi hi.
Tua laitak Jerusalem khua-a kipan Judea gam bup leh Jordan gun kiim mun citeng pan mite ama' kiangah hong pai uh a,
a mawhnate uh pulakin Jordan gun sungah ama' baptizena sang uh hi.
Ahih hangin John in Pharisee-te leh Sadducee-te tampitak ama' baptizena sang ding hong pai a muh ciangin, “No mualtan' suante! Hong tung ding hehna pan taikhiat ding kua in hong phawng hiam?
Tu-in kisikna tawh a kituak gah, gah un.
Noleno, ‘I pa Abraham i nei hi,’ a ci thei ding kisakha kei un. A hang pen ke'n kong cihin ah Pasian in hih suangtumte pan Abraham' ading suanlekhak khangkhiasak thei hi.
Tu mahmahin zong singkungte a phung ah hei kikoih hi. Gah hoih a gah lo singkung khempeuh kiphukin mei sungah kilawn hi.

“Kisikna hangin tui tawh note kong baptize hi. Ahih hangin kei' nunga hong pai dingpa kei sangin lianzaw a, ama' khedap tawi dingin zong ka kilawm kei hi. Amah in Kha Siangtho leh mei tawh note hong baptize ding hi.
Amah in a khut ah buhpholhna singka tawi-in buhphal cilna tual hahsiang ding a, buhtangte ansal sungah khawm ding hi. Ahi zongin buhvai ansite a mit ngeilo mei tawh haltum ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin John' kiangah baptizena sang dingin Galilee pan Jordan gun ah Jesu pai hi.
John in Jesu kho a, “Kei, nang' baptize ding a kisam kimlai nang, kei' kiang hong pai zawsop na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in, “Dikna thu khempeuh i tangtunsak ding a kilawm thu ahih manin tu-in tua bang hisak hoh in,” ci-in dawng hi. Tua ciangin John in a thu mang hi.
Jesu a kibaptize khit, tui sungpan a dintoh phetin, en un, ama' ading vantung hong kihong a, tua ciangin amah in vakhu banga hong kumsuk, ama' tungah a khawl, Pasian' Kha mu hi.
Tua ciangin, ngai un, vantung pan awging khat in, “Hih pen ka it ka Tapa hi; ama' tungah ka lungkim mahmah hi,” ci hi.
